_about: Hormozi (studied from Alex Hormozi's own 2026 Shorts, 12 Oct 2026, ~/reels/focus-refs/hormozi): clean authority edit. Red rounded title box (white heavy caps) under the caption for the hook, a white lower-third name card with avatar and red edge, clean white sentence-case captions 2-4 words with the keyword in heavy weight, a split screen numbered list (black bottom half, red numbers) when he counts points, small grey parenthetical notes, hard wide/close punch cuts, natural grade, no music.

director.rules: hz-title on the hook (the video's promise in 3-6 words, caps), hz-name once early, hz-list whenever the speaker counts points (items = what he says), hz-note only for a short clarifying aside. Keep it clean: no B-roll unless essential, no stickers.
director.style: Authority: a clean, hard cut. Alternate a wide and a close framing on hard cuts about every 2.4 s, never a dissolve. Natural grade, no music.
director.restraint: Clean above all: one title on the hook, a list only where he counts, nothing else. No B-roll, no icons, no stickers, no invented names.
